_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
!bash closes its terminal tab after EOF. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-eof-bash. Call "terminals" says how many terminals the server still has for this conversation. The test's init script sets window.__terminalsHydrated, a promise that resolves to "hydrated" once the page has fetched GET /api/terminals (which restores the server's terminals as tabs) and has had a turn to render the result. "The terminal input" is the visible terminal's input, '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]' (other terminals' inputs are hidden); to type into it, focus it with an eval (.focus()), then use type steps, which type key by key, and press_key for Enter or Control+d. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-eof-bash. Fill [data-testid="message-input"] with "!bash" and click [data-testid="send-button"]. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-running".
2. Readline handles EOF at an empty prompt. Synchronize with the shell by waiting for a marker in real terminal output, not just the open socket: type into the terminal input, key by key, the 19 characters printf 'shell-ready\n' (a backslash and an n, not a newline), then press Enter.
3. Retry the following steps as one block until they pass (timeout 15s): choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input" (both clicks inside the block); then the message input's value must match /shell-ready\r?\n/ (eval /shell-ready\r?\n/.test(document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value) with expect true).
4. The insert focuses the message input in a zero-delay timeout: let that timeout run first (eval, awaited: new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve("flushed"), 0)), expect "flushed"), then focus the terminal input again (eval .focus()) and press Control+d.
5. There should be no ".terminal-panel-tab" (count 0), and ".terminal-panel" should be hidden.
6. Call "terminals" should return "0".
7. Reload. Wait until the page has restored the server's terminals (eval, awaited: window.__terminalsHydrated, expect "hydrated"). There should be no ".terminal-panel-tab" (count 0).
